verdicts.reason: A: the CTA sits before the headline on the far left, the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow and button are squeezed against the top edge, and the legal copy on the right is tiny at 320x50. Still, the headline, subcopy, can and a readable Shop Sale button all survive in a sensible banner flow. B is worse: it opens with the fine print on the far left, puts the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow below its own subcopy, and shrinks the CTA into an unreadable black sliver beside the can, so the button is effectively lost.
